import { cx } from './cx.js';

type WidgetTone = 'calm' | 'loud';

export function Widget({
  tone = 'calm',
  selected = false,
  slot,
  className,
}: {
  tone?: WidgetTone;
  selected?: boolean;
  slot: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const classes = cx('widget', `widget--${tone}`, selected && 'widget--selected', className);
  return (
    <div className={classes} data-selected={selected ? 'true' : 'false'} data-gap="2">
      <span className={tone === 'loud' ? 'widget__icon' : 'widget__ghost'} />
      <span className={['widget__body', 'type-body'].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} />
      <span className={`slot__${slot}`} />
      <span className={`unstyled__${slot}`} />
    </div>
  );
}
